<thought>Using the functional group list, I will search for templates that form ether oxygens and break aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, which matches the described cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. I will use the flavanone SMILES O=C1C(Cc2ccccc2)Oc3ccccc13 as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(Cc2ccccc2)Oc3ccccc13",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
